itens.prompt: The young adventurer in side view facing right, feet planted on the same ground line, same camera angle. Frames 1-2: the right fist, gripping an invisible sword hilt, lifts up and back above the head while the torso leans back and the knees bend. Frames 3-4: the body snaps forward and the arm swings down in a heavy diagonal arc across the body, shoulders and hips driving the swing, the front foot pressing into the ground. Frames 5-6: a short follow-through with the arm extended low in front, the backpack and messy hair bouncing. Frames 7-8: recover smoothly to the starting standing pose. Hands only, nothing drawn in the hand, no effects. Keep the same outline, colors and proportions in every frame.
itens.negativo: weapon, sword, turning around, back view, facing the camera, extra limbs, motion lines, speed effects, text
conferir: Corpo sempre de lado, virado para a direita (nenhum quadro de costas ou de frente).
Braço sobe atrás da cabeça nos quadros 1-2 e desce na diagonal nos 3-4 (o acerto do jogo cai nos quadros 3-5).
Nada desenhado na mão, sem linhas de movimento.
Último quadro volta à pose parada.
itens.alerta: O 1º teste (mãos vazias) saiu como soco. Aqui o pedido é 'segurando um cabo invisível'; se vier soco de novo, repetir com 'both hands gripping' no lugar.

itens.prompt: The young adventurer in side view facing right, feet planted on the same ground line, same camera angle. Frames 1-2: a sudden hit, the head and shoulders snap backward, the torso arches and the arms lift slightly from the hips. Frames 3-4: the knees bend and he staggers one small step backward while the backpack swings forward. Frames 5-6: he steadies his feet and straightens up. Frames 7-8: settle smoothly back into the starting standing pose. No effects, no impact stars, no text. Keep the same outline, colors and proportions in every frame.
itens.negativo: turning around, back view, facing the camera, extra limbs, impact stars, blood, motion lines, text
conferir: Cabeça e ombros para trás nos quadros 1-2.
Um pequeno passo para trás (pés não deslizam).
Sem estrelas nem sangue.
Volta à pose parada no fim.

itens.prompt: The young adventurer in side view facing right, same camera angle, on the same ground line. Frames 1-3: struck hard, the head snaps back, the arms fling outward and the torso arches. Frames 4-6: the knees buckle and he drops down onto his knees with his head hanging. Frames 7-9: he topples backward onto the ground, the backpack landing first. Frames 10-12: he lies flat on his back on the ground line, motionless, the last frame held perfectly still. No effects, no blood, no text. Keep the same outline, colors and proportions in every frame.
itens.negativo: turning around, facing the camera, extra limbs, blood, ghost, halo, motion lines, text
conferir: Cai para trás e termina deitado, imóvel, na linha do chão.
O último quadro (12) é um quadro parado.
Sem sangue, fantasma ou efeito.
O corpo cabe no quadro de 80x80.
itens.alerta: 12 quadros custam o mesmo que 8. Se o quadro 12 não ficar parado, o jogo segura o último quadro por código.

itens.prompt: The young adventurer in side view facing right, feet planted on the same ground line, same camera angle. Frames 1-2: he inhales deeply, the chest rises and the shoulders lift. Frames 3-5: both fists clench at the hips, the head tilts up and he exhales strongly while the body straightens with determination. Frames 6-8: he relaxes and settles back into the starting standing pose. No glow, no effects, no text. Keep the same outline, colors and proportions in every frame.
itens.negativo: turning around, back view, facing the camera, extra limbs, glow, sparkles, text
conferir: Respira fundo e solta, sem brilho (o brilho é feito por código).
Sempre de lado, à direita.

itens.prompt: The young adventurer in side view facing right, feet planted on the same ground line, same camera angle. Frames 1-2: he crouches slightly with both fists clenched and the jaw set. Frames 3-5: an explosive burst, the body leans hard forward, the arms pump back and the backpack swings, a fierce determined face. Frames 6-8: he holds an aggressive ready stance leaning forward, then eases back toward the starting pose. No effects, no aura, no text. Keep the same outline, colors and proportions in every frame.
itens.negativo: turning around, back view, facing the camera, extra limbs, aura, glow, motion lines, text
conferir: Agacha e explode para a frente nos quadros 3-5.
Sem aura (a aura é por código).

itens.prompt: The young adventurer in side view facing right, on the same ground line, same camera angle. Frames 1-2: he crouches low and leans forward. Frames 3-6: he tucks into a forward roll along the ground, the body curled into a ball with the backpack on top, rotating once toward the right. Frames 7-8: he springs back up onto his feet into the starting standing pose. No effects, no dust, no text. Keep the same outline, colors and proportions in every frame.
itens.negativo: turning around, facing the camera, extra limbs, dust, motion lines, text
conferir: Rola uma vez para a direita e volta de pé.
Sem poeira (a poeira é por código).

itens.prompt: A small scrawny goblin, side profile facing right, large pointy ears, olive green skin, dirty brown rags, a rusty dagger in the right hand and a sly grin, cute chibi proportions, clean dark outline, readable silhouette, full body
conferir: Lado, virado para a direita, corpo inteiro.
Menor que o herói (Pequeno no livro).
Adaga na mão direita (ficha: adaga).
Mesmo traço do herói: contorno escuro, proporções fofas.
itens.alerta: Gera 1 imagem base (12). As animações só valem se a base estiver boa: se não, refazer a base antes de animar.

conferir: Respira e balança as orelhas, sem sair do lugar.

itens.alerta: O preparo da pose custa +12 (uma vez por rodada). Serve também de correr: o jogo acelera o andar.

itens.prompt: The goblin in side view facing right, feet planted on the same ground line, same camera angle. Frames 1-2: the dagger hand pulls back beside the hip while the shoulders hunch. Frames 3-4: a quick stabbing lunge, the body snaps forward and the arm extends fully with the dagger pointing ahead. Frames 5-6: hold the extended pose briefly, then pull the arm back. Frames 7-8: return to the guarded stance. The dagger keeps the same size and color. No effects, no text.
itens.negativo: turning around, back view, facing the camera, extra weapons, extra limbs, motion lines, text
conferir: Braço estica nos quadros 3-4 (o acerto do jogo: 0,1 a 0,3 s).
A adaga não muda de tamanho nem de cor.

itens.prompt: The goblin in side view facing right, feet planted on the same ground line, same camera angle. Frames 1-2: the throwing arm cocks back behind the head with the dagger raised, the body leaning back. Frames 3-4: an overhand throw, the arm whips forward and the hand opens at release, the body leaning into the throw. Frames 5-6: follow-through with the arm extended forward and the hand empty. Frames 7-8: return to the guarded stance. The thrown dagger is not drawn after release and nothing flies through the air. No effects, no text.
itens.negativo: turning around, back view, facing the camera, flying dagger, projectile, motion lines, extra limbs, text
conferir: A adaga sai da mão no quadro 3-4 e a mão fica vazia (a adaga voando é do jogo).
Nada voando no quadro.
itens.alerta: Se a adaga continuar desenhada voando, recortar por código ou refazer.

itens.prompt: (preset 'hurt' do SpriteCook, sem texto próprio)
conferir: Recua com o impacto e volta à pose.
itens.alerta: Economia: o jogo já treme e pisca ao apanhar. Se faltar crédito, este quadro pode ficar de fora (-14).

itens.prompt: (preset 'death' do SpriteCook, sem texto próprio)
conferir: Cai e fica deitado, imóvel, no último quadro.
itens.alerta: Economia: dá para trocar por cair e sumir por código (-14).

itens.prompt: A goblin warrior, side profile facing right, green skin, large pointy ears, a scarred cheek, studded leather armor, a small round wooden shield on the left arm and a curved scimitar in the right hand, cute chibi proportions, clean dark outline, readable silhouette, full body
